title: profiles.validate_display_name
description: Payload for the profiles.validate_display_name comm Function — the display-name canon on its own, no write and no side effect, for a caller that stores a name of its own which will be displayed beside the ones profiles keeps. Returns {"ok": bool, "reason": str|null} with reason as the trailing name of a profiles error key. The empty string is valid (clearing a name is not a violation).
